class.name: OcgGCMakehyperbola2d
class.brief_description: This class implements construction algorithms for hyperbolas in the plane. The result is a `Geom2d_Hyperbola` (main branch). A `GC_MakeHyperbola2d` object provides a framework for: - defining the construction parameters; - running the construction algorithm; - querying the construction status and the resulting hyperbola via `Value()`.
class.description: ! This class implements construction algorithms for hyperbolas in the plane. ! The result is a `Geom2d_Hyperbola` (main branch). ! A `GC_MakeHyperbola2d` object provides a framework for: ! - defining the construction parameters; ! - running the construction algorithm; ! - querying the construction status and the resulting hyperbola via `Value()`. ! @note Hyperbola parameterization range is ]-infinite, +infinite[. ! @note In the local coordinate system, the X axis is the major axis ! and the Y axis is the minor axis.

method.name: from_1
method.description: Creates a hyperbola from a non-persistent one from package gp.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a hyperbola from local coordinate system and radii.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates a hyperbola from two apex points and center point.

method.name: from_4
method.description: Creates a hyperbola from major axis placement and radii.
